messages:
Priya Patel: Dropping a new compact-row mock for autoscale. Goals: show Min/Max, Burst toggle, selected GPU pool, and a tiny latency target indicator inline. Fig: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/2356009876/compact-row-v3.png
Alex Chen: Nice density. Quick callouts: 1) latency target must have a numeric label visible on keyboard focus, 2) burst toggle looks like a CTA — make it an outline chip.
Maya Rivera: Agree on outline chip. Also propose adding a tiny "duration" affordance to burst: users assume its permanent unless we show "+15m" or "until end of spike".
Jordan Lee: From eng: adding duration means more state. Could support quick presets (15m/1h/auto) in the burst popover. Implementation: popover content lazy-rendered, OK for perf.
Samir Gupta: Billing note: if we add presets, show estimated incremental cost per preset in the popover. Avoid surprise charges. We can show a small calc: "+0.12 USD / min" per GPU.
A11yBot: Scanner: burst chip contrast 2.5:1 (fail). Latency thin rail fails contrast too. Add aria-labels: "Latency target 150ms" and ensure slider uses role=\"slider\" with aria-valuemin/max/now.
Priya Patel: UX decision candidates: a) show duration preset in burst popover with cost estimate, b) show latency numeric on focus, c) collapsed pool name for single-pool accounts. Thumbs?
Alex Chen: Thumbs up for all. Also keyboard nav: pool chevron must be Tab stop. Up/Down navigate the list, Enter selects. Slider Left/Right = 10ms, Home/End jump. Show value inline when focused.
Maya Rivera: Copy tweak: card label use "Latency target" instead of raw "SLO" to reduce jargon. Keep "SLO" in advanced details.
Jordan Lee: Perf ask: can we lazy-load the burst popover and the tiny cost calc only when the popover opens or card intersects viewport? I'll verify with an IntersectionObserver; should drop initial paint cost.
Samir Gupta: Analytics ask: product analytics — we need an event when user changes burst duration/preset to measure usage and billing impact. @DevOpsBot can we track that?
DevOpsBot: Created ticket INF-724 to add tracking events: burst_change, burst_preset_selected, latency_target_updated. Link: https://redwood-internal.tracker/INF-724
A11yBot: Also recommend focus-visible CSS token: `--focus-ring: 3px solid #FFD54F;` and role=\"alert\" for validation errors like "Min cannot exceed Max".
Priya Patel: Great. Maya, can you post the updated mock with duration presets and darker rail by EOD? Alex/Jordan will add keyboard notes & perf plan. We'll reconvene after Jordan posts perf numbers.
Alex Chen: On it. I'll add visible numeric readout on focus and outline burst chip in the figma.
Jordan Lee: I'll run a perf test with 120 rows on staging and share paint/frame timings here (ETA ~2h).
Maya Rivera: Will push the mock and copy changes shortly. Thanks all!
